nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: LogRhythm Smart Response POSTs {"alarmId": <int>}. Add {"demo": true, "label": "TEST"} for a test run. Add Header Auth here before exposing it publicly.

nodes.name: Is Duplicate?
nodes.notes: true = this alarm id was already handled in the last 2 minutes.

nodes.name: Get Alarm Details
nodes.notes: Set your LogRhythm host and a Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <JWT>). Self-signed cert is allowed. If this fails after the retries the run stops and the Error Trigger reports it.

nodes.name: Wait
nodes.notes: Gives LogRhythm time to finish caching the drilldown.

nodes.name: Get Drilldown
nodes.notes: LogRhythm answers HTTP 202 when the drilldown is ready - that is success. If this fails after the retries the run stops and the Error Trigger reports it.

nodes.name: Extract IOCs + Filter
nodes.notes: Finds the remote (attacker) IP, what was hit (internal host or the perimeter device) and whether the connection was allowed.

nodes.name: Has IOC To Enrich?
nodes.notes: false = no public remote IP in the logs: the four lookups are skipped and the alarm is scored without them.

nodes.name: VirusTotal
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name x-apikey, value = your VirusTotal key. HTTP errors (404 / 429) are passed on as data so the Risk node can tell 'never seen' from 'quota exhausted' from 'down'.

nodes.name: AbuseIPDB
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name Key, value = your AbuseIPDB key.

nodes.name: GreyNoise
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name key, value = your GreyNoise key (Community API). A 404 means the IP was never seen scanning the internet. No key? Deactivate this node and set 'GreyNoise' to false in SOURCES_ENABLED at the top of Risk + MITRE Engine.

nodes.name: AlienVault OTX
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name X-OTX-API-KEY, value = your OTX key.

nodes.name: Risk + MITRE Engine
nodes.notes: Deterministic score and level (RBP + 4 per flagging threat-intel source + context points), API-failure handling, MITRE mapping and the LLM prompt. All tunables are at the top of the code.

nodes.name: API Problem To Report?
nodes.notes: true = a threat-intel API is down or out of quota (at most one message per source per hour).

nodes.name: Mattermost: API health
nodes.notes: Tells the team an API key is exhausted or an API is not answering. Point it at your ops / infra channel.

nodes.name: LLM Analyst Summary
nodes.notes: A locally hosted model. LLM_STYLE in Risk + MITRE Engine picks the request format: 'openai' for /v1/chat/completions (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp), 'ollama' for the native /api/chat. 'localhost' is the n8n host itself - use a LAN IP or host.docker.internal if the model runs elsewhere. If your server needs an API key, switch Authentication to Header Auth.

nodes.name: Parse Summary
nodes.notes: Falls back to a rule-based summary if the LLM is down or replies with junk.

nodes.name: Severity Router
nodes.notes: critical / high: email + Slack + Mattermost. medium: Slack + Mattermost. low: nobody is paged (the verdict is still written to the alarm in LogRhythm).

nodes.name: Send an Email
nodes.notes: Needs an SMTP credential. Set the recipient(s) in 'To Email'.

nodes.name: Slack: #soc-alerts
nodes.notes: Needs a Slack credential. Set the channel in 'Channel'.

nodes.name: Mattermost: #soc-alerts
nodes.notes: Mattermost incoming webhook for the alert channel.

nodes.name: Low: Nobody Paged
nodes.notes: Low severity: no email / Slack / Mattermost. The verdict is still written to the alarm in LogRhythm.

nodes.name: Log to LogRhythm
nodes.notes: Writes the verdict (level, score, intel, summary) to the alarm as a comment, whatever the level.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: In Workflow Settings set 'Error Workflow' to this workflow so a failed run (for example LogRhythm unreachable) lands here.

nodes.name: Delivery Failed
nodes.notes: Every delivery node (email, Slack, Mattermost, LogRhythm comment) keeps going when it fails and reports here, so one broken channel never blocks the others.

parameters.content:
## Inbound Alarm Triage (DEMO)

Runs end to end on **pinned sample data**: no LogRhythm, no API keys, nothing is sent anywhere.

**Run it:** click *Execute workflow*. The pinned Webhook feeds a synthetic alarm (client *Acme Corp*: a Tor exit node connecting to RDP on an internal server) through every stage.

**Flow:** validate + dedupe > alarm + drilldown > attacker IP > VirusTotal / AbuseIPDB / GreyNoise / OTX > risk score + MITRE > local LLM summary > severity router > email / Slack / Mattermost.

**Go live:** replace the example hosts and Mattermost hooks, create the credentials named in each node's notes, and set the recipients. At the top of *Risk + MITRE Engine*: score cut-offs, points per threat-intel source and their thresholds, console link, logo, model. All sample data is synthetic (203.0.113.0/24 is a documentation range).
